turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Mr. Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so start with why my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of your class.
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.
"A machine's guess. Ninety-four percent of what, exactly? Did anyone ask Owen a single question before you entered that mark?"
I don't need more proof than that.
"'Don't need more proof.' I'm writing that down. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish a concern. Which part of that did you miss?"
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.

"Its maker tells schools not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student. I have that printout in my bag. So you're relying on something its own company says not to rely on. Is that your position?"
"Zero stands." Okay. Then you'll have to defend it to the principal this afternoon, because I'm not leaving here without him, and without knowing who decided this and when.
